findings.title: Repeated fraction labels emit duplicate anchors and ambiguous section-qualified links
findings.expected: LFTR Article180Bis expressly cites CPEUM20 ApartadoB fractionI; a specific fraction link must uniquely identify B.I, or fall back to the article when that scope is unavailable.

actual.source_text_excerpt: artículo20, ApartadoB, fracciónI (spacing preserved in generated evidence)
target_anchor_definition_prefixes: I. El proceso penal tendrá por objeto el esclarecimiento de los hechos, proteger al inocente, procurar que el culpable no quede impune y que los daños causados por el delito se reparen;
I. A que se presuma su inocencia mientras no se declare su responsabilidad mediante sentencia emitida por el juez de la causa;

I. Recibir asesoría jurídica; ser informado de los derechos que en su favor establece la Constitución y, cuando lo solicite, ser informado del desarrollo del procedimiento penal; II. Coadyuvar con el Ministerio

findings.cause: The target registry stores a set of roman numerals with no section or occurrence identity; rendering emits the same f-i anchor for each top-level I paragraph. The qualifier consumer treats membership as proof of a unique anchor.
findings.fix_suggestion: Build a shared registry of actually emitted unique anchors. Suppress ambiguous fraction-specific links and use the whole article until canonical qualifier scope can select a unique section-aware target; do not guess from occurrence order. If section-aware anchors are added, preserve that scope explicitly across parser/validation/export contracts.
findings.scope_limit: No claim about which duplicate Obsidian chooses at runtime; the exported destination cannot uniquely designate B.I. Source extraction context was not re-audited.

findings.title: Definition links advertise fraction anchors that are never emitted
findings.expected: A Desvío term link in LFCSQ must target an existing uniquely identified definition block or a safe whole-note fallback.

actual.related_second_missing_anchor: LFCSQ Polígono de Inspección fractionXXVI also receives f-xxvi links with zero anchor definitions.

findings.cause: term_anchor blindly derives f-<fraction>, but with_block_anchors only recognizes fractions at paragraph starts. These valid canonical definitions begin inline after another definition in the same paragraph, so no matching block anchor is rendered.
findings.fix_suggestion: Generate TermTargets from the same actual anchor registry used by rendering. Either split rendered definition blocks at validated definition spans and emit real unique anchors, or fall back to a whole-note link when no anchor exists. Preserve canonical source text.
findings.scope_limit: Metadata-only inventory identified142 fraction-term targets with usages lacking paragraph-leading anchors; only the named LFCSQ targets were independently rendered and checked here.

findings.title: Standard Markdown chooses local targets by display acronym rather than instrument identity
findings.cause: The local-versus-cross-instrument branch compares short_name. Distinct instruments sharing an acronym resolve a genuine cross-instrument edge to the source instrument local article, even though target ID and slug remain distinct.
findings.fix_suggestion: Carry instrument identity in LinkTarget and compare that identity with corpus.instrument.id; use slug only to construct a cross-instrument relative path. Display short names must not control identity.
findings.scope_limit: Private synthetic change of only CPEUM.short_name to LFTR. All current467 committed instrument short names were unique in the metadata scan; no live current collision claimed.
